title: In This World You Float When You're Happy
description: Kids bump the ceiling all day, but the noodle shop owner hasn't left the floor in fifteen years, and Yui wants to know why. What would make you float? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Mr. Goto: 58-year-old Japanese noodle shop owner, stocky, short graying buzz cut, thick black eyebrows, permanent frown, white cotton cook's jacket with sleeves rolled up, dark navy apron, white towel tied around his forehead, heavy clunky black iron-soled boots, no hat, no glasses
characters.Yui: 10-year-old Japanese girl, black hair in a single high ponytail with a plain red hair tie, sailor-style navy and white school uniform with a red neckerchief, white knee socks, brown school shoes, small red school backpack, no hat
characters.Kid: 7-year-old Japanese boy, round face, short bowl-cut black hair, yellow T-shirt, blue shorts, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, you float when you're happy. Kids bump the ceiling all day. But Mr. Goto, who runs the corner noodle shop, hasn't left the floor in fifteen years.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On a quiet 1990s Japanese shopping street in the afternoon, Kid laughs and drifts a few feet off the ground past a small closed shop front with no writing on it. [4-7s] Inside a small wooden 1990s Japanese noodle shop with plain walls and no writing anywhere, Mr. Goto stands flat-footed behind the counter, stirring a big steaming pot, frowning. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of Mr. Goto's heavy black boots planted firmly on the wooden floor.

scenes.say: Ten-year-old Yui eats there every day after school. She notices two things: his heavy black boots clank like anchors, and he never smiles. Not at babies, not at puppies.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui sits on a stool at the wooden counter slurping noodles, eyes on Mr. Goto. [4-7s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of Mr. Goto's black boots stomping heavily across the floorboards. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui narrows her eyes thoughtfully, chopsticks frozen in mid-air.

scenes.say: So Yui makes it her mission. Monday, her best joke. Wednesday, a borrowed puppy. Friday, a perfect paper crane. Mr. Goto just nods once and keeps stirring the pot.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui leans over the counter telling a joke with big hand gestures while Mr. Goto stares blankly. [4-7s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui holds up a fluffy brown puppy toward Mr. Goto, who nods once without expression. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of Yui placing a small white paper crane on the wooden counter next to his steaming pot.

scenes.say: But on Friday he turns away too fast, and Yui hears it. The floorboards under his boots creak and strain, like something under that frown is desperately trying to go up.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Mr. Goto turns his back sharply to Yui, his shoulders tense. [4-7s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of the wooden floorboards bending upward around his heavy black boots, the bootlaces pulled tight. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui leans over the counter staring down at his boots, mouth open.

scenes.say: She asks him straight out. Mr. Goto sighs. Fifteen years ago he laughed, floated, and dumped a pot of hot soup on a customer. He's worn iron boots ever since.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Mr. Goto sits on a stool behind the counter and rubs his face with both hands, embarrassed. [4-7s] Inside the same small noodle shop, flashback in faded colors, a younger Mr. Goto laughs and floats up while a big pot of soup tips from his hands. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of Mr. Goto patting his heavy black boot with a sheepish little smile.

scenes.say: So Yui offers to carry the bowls. Mr. Goto unlaces both boots and drifts straight to the ceiling, laughing. In this world, happy people float. He just needed a soup carrier.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Yui carefully carries a steaming bowl of noodles in both hands toward a table. [4-7s] Inside the same small noodle shop, close-up of two heavy black boots left empty on the wooden floor. [7-10s] Inside the same small noodle shop, Mr. Goto floats up near the wooden ceiling beams, laughing loudly, while Yui grins up at him holding the bowl and the paper crane drifts beside him.
